# v3 phase 2: pre-war events (generated by tools/build_focus_turmoil.py)
add_namespace = nsr

country_event = {
	id = nsr.201
	title = nsr.201.t
	desc = nsr.201.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_read_write
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = nsr.201.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 2 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_hold_cap_p4
		hidden_effect = {
			capital_scope = {
				set_temp_variable = { NSR_hold_delta = 4 }
				NSR_state_hold_change = yes
			}
		}
		add_power_balance_value = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop value = 0.02 tooltip_side = NSR_bop_ikhwan_side }
	}
	option = {
		name = nsr.201.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
		add_political_power = -25
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_hold_cap_p6
		hidden_effect = {
			capital_scope = {
				set_temp_variable = { NSR_hold_delta = 6 }
				NSR_state_hold_change = yes
			}
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_fitna_p3
		hidden_effect = {
			add_to_variable = { NSR_fitna = 3 }
			NSR_clamp_turmoil = yes
		}
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = nsr.216
	title = nsr.216.t
	desc = nsr.216.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_soldiers_marching
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = nsr.216.a
		trigger = { any_country = { original_tag = SPR has_civil_war = yes } }
		ai_chance = { factor = 2 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_muhajirun_p2
		hidden_effect = {
			add_to_variable = { NSR_muhajirun = 2 }
			NSR_clamp_turmoil = yes
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_fitna_p3
		hidden_effect = {
			add_to_variable = { NSR_fitna = 3 }
			NSR_clamp_turmoil = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = SPR }
			SPR = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = NSR_hijrah_rif } }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = nsr.216.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
		add_power_balance_value = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop value = 0.02 tooltip_side = NSR_bop_ikhwan_side }
		add_stability = 0.02
	}
	option = {
		name = nsr.216.c
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_bayt_al_mal_p30
		hidden_effect = {
			add_to_variable = { NSR_bayt_al_mal = 30 }
			NSR_clamp_turmoil = yes
		}
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = nsr.217
	title = nsr.217.t
	desc = nsr.217.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_read_write
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = nsr.217.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 2 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_muhajirun_p1
		hidden_effect = {
			add_to_variable = { NSR_muhajirun = 1 }
			NSR_clamp_turmoil = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = SAU }
			SAU = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = NSR_hijrah_najd } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = NSR_najd_brothers_joined } }
			random = {
				chance = 50
				country_event = { id = nsr.60 days = 20 }
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = nsr.217.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
		add_power_balance_value = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop value = 0.02 tooltip_side = NSR_bop_ikhwan_side }
	}
}
